output.title: Environment sets the new global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole value
output.content: v1.18.0 adds the global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole helm value, which disables HTTP-01 ACME challenges and drops cert-manager's permission to create pods. The environment's values set global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole, so this change directly applies. Inspect its value and confirm none of your issuers need HTTP-01 challenges before upgrading.
